title: Ceiling and Wall Survey Time for Mold Remediation After Water Losses
content:
Supervisor's guide: survey time on the Mold Remediation work-plan visit follows the IICRC water class recorded on the linked Water Damage Mitigation job, judged as that job's records stood on the mold job's opened date, the day of the visit.

Growth behind a linked water job of water Class 3, where water came from overhead and saturated the ceilings, adds the ceiling survey hours of 1.0 hour to the visit hours; growth behind a linked water job of Class 2 adds the wall survey hours of 0.5 hours; every other job adds no overhead-survey hours.

| Water class on the linked water job | Survey | Hours added |
|---|---|---|
| Class 3 | Ceiling survey | 1.0 |
| Class 2 | Wall survey | 0.5 |
| Any other class | — | None |
| No linked water job | — | None |
